description: Went up once with salt water and did not ask to see.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Drew the tooth, showed the three roots, and charged twelve pence.
name: Barnaby Yaxley

description: Had the broth ready and forbade the stair to everyone but Alse, once.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Wrote the line and did not cast a total.
name: William Shakespeare
